::: {#hero-heading}

Hello, I am *Md Osman Gani Bhuiyan*.

I am a microbiologist with a strong interest in bioinformatics, computational biology, genomics, and cancer research. I am passionate about integrating biological and computational approaches to explore complex biological questions and contribute to biomedical research. I aspire to pursue a PhD and develop interdisciplinary expertise at the intersection of microbiology, genomics, and computational science.

Currently, I am working as Research Assistant at [CHIRAL](https://chiralbd.github.io/).Also, I'm a Executive, Quality Control – Microbiology @ Aristopharma Ltd.

:::
